_description: ISCA'27 P21 round 2: m3p_pa.json with every realism switch on: tracking table 1024 pages per GPM (LRU, evicted pages forget their counts), 1 us from decision to action, pre-placements and replica creations in per-GPM driver batches of 256 paying the 5 us software latency, 2 ns redirect lookup at translation (separate table model; the access is held at the address translator) for pages with block homes or replicas, 1024 block-home entries per GPM (uniform pre-placements remap to fresh frames, block falls back to move, spread skipped when full); counters are the hardware summary (Misra-Gries: 2 GPM counters per page, 1 per 1 KB block).
